quote: Persons riding bicycles, electric bicycles or electric scooters upon a roadway shall not ride more than two abreast except on paths or parts of roadways set aside for the exclusive use of bicycles, electric bicycles and electric scooters.

activation.condition: Qualifying bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter riders occupy a roadway.

obligation.description: Do not ride more than two abreast on roadway outside the exclusive-use exception.

exceptions.source_clause: except on paths or parts of roadways set aside for the exclusive use of bicycles, electric bicycles and electric scooters.
exceptions.description: Source-designated exclusive-use paths or parts of roadways.

timing.description: Measure continuous rider arrangement from original frames; preserve legal abreast interpretation.

parameter_refs.name: rider_count
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: two or three separate bicycle riders
